verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an email provider with inboxes, a console and IMAP access, so tracker protection and data-use transparency are fair questions to ask of it. The evidence never mentions blocking read or tracking pixels, image proxying, or a data-use policy. SOC 2 compliance and allow/block Lists are adjacent features and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a switcher, the client protects me from senders' tracking — blocking read pixels by default — and is transparent about what it does with my mail data
